newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag's Schmalbach shows 96 oper profit jump.
newsitem.headline: Viag's Schmalbach shows 96 oper profit jump.

text.p: German diversified industrial group VIAG AG said on Friday that operating profit rose significantly at its Schmalbach-Lubeca AG unit last year.
Viag however declined to give an actual number. In 1995 Schmalbach, which manufactures beverage containers, posted an operating profit of 118 million marks.
Viag also did not detail the unit's sales.
A cooler summer dampened sales of beverage containers, Viag said, adding however that cost cutting were successful in helping boost Schmalbach's operating profit.
Viag's activities span power generation, the manufacture of packaging and chemicals, distribution and logistics, and telecommunications.
For the company as a whole the 1996 operating profit before tax rose to just under 2.4 billion marks from 2.1 billion marks according to provisional figures, Viag said in a statement.
Group sales rose to about 42.5 billion marks from 41.9 billion marks, Viag added.
